name: Insurance Claims Multi-Agents
description: An agentic AI claims demo powered by advanced multi-agent systems (agent-framework + Azure OpenAI GPT-4.1) that streamlines the end-to-end insurance claims process. This proof-of-concept uses specialized AI agents to collaboratively assess claims and provide instant, transparent, explainable recommendations to claims processors. It augments human decision-making to accelerate handling from hours to minutes while improving consistency, transparency, and customer satisfaction.
